# Isaiah Chapter 6 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 13 verses]*

*Temple vision; seraphim; Isaiah's lips cleansed; divine commission; message of judgment*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 6 (Isaiah's Commission) addresses temple vision; seraphim; isaiah's lips cleansed; divine commission; message of judgment. The key verse — "Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts; the whole earth is full of his glory" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to First Isaiah (chs. 1-39), focused on judgment and the Assyrian crisis.
